name: storage-cleanup
description: 按类目查看内容、.trash 和插件数据的存储占用，安全清理大文件、空文件，并清空 .trash 文件夹。 View storage use across vault content, .trash, and plugin data by category, then safely clean up large files, empty files, and the .trash folder.
author: Jiao Yingxing

scripts.build:runtime: npm run build && npm run sync:runtime && npm run verify:runtime
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:meta && npm run check:docs
